cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(AtlasMemorySanitizers LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(SDL3 3.4 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
add_executable(atlas_memory_sanitizers native_atlas_cpu_sanitize.cpp)
target_compile_features(atlas_memory_sanitizers PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(atlas_memory_sanitizers PRIVATE "${ATLAS_HEADER_DIR}")
target_compile_options(atlas_memory_sanitizers PRIVATE -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
target_link_options(atlas_memory_sanitizers PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
target_link_libraries(atlas_memory_sanitizers PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3 ZLIB::ZLIB)
